>

> - **Codified in IaC (Terraform, Helm, GitOps)**
> - **Enforced at runtime (Kubernetes admission, NGINX, Prometheus, ALB)**
> - **Monitored in real time (OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Grafana)**
> - **Auditable via immutable logs (CloudTrail, auditd, ELK)**

>
> The exact threshold of **89.0 ms (p95)** is not a goal — it is a **hard boundary**, enforced with zero tolerance for deviation. Any breach triggers immediate alerting, rollback, and incident response.
